name: Career Boost (formerly Higher Level Skills)
summary: Subsidised priority skill sets and Certificate IV or higher courses for Queenslanders; students pay a co-contribution fee.
key: Career Boost helps Queenslanders develop higher-level skills needed to secure employment, advance their careers, or progress to further education.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or NZ citizen living in Queensland.
No Certificate IV or higher completed in the last 10 years.
how: Enrol with an approved provider such as TAFE Queensland.
catches: Eligibility here is from TAFE Queensland's summary; the official Career Boost page could not be opened.

evidence.quote: Career Boost helps Queenslanders develop higher-level skills needed to secure employment, advance their careers, or progress to further education.
assist individuals to gain the skills required to secure employment or career advancement.
